name: Shinta Mani Mustang
summary: Shinta Mani Mustang, designed by Bill Bensley and opened in August 2023 in Jomsom, is the first luxury resort in Mustang. Its 29 suites are built of local stone and timber in Thakali style, with a spa, restaurant and guided adventures into Lower and Upper Mustang.
body: The resort stands at about 2,800 m on the edge of Jomsom, built from Baglung stone and timber to echo the flat-roofed Thakali houses of the valley. The 29 suites face the mountains, with interiors in soft natural fabrics, local textiles and reclaimed furniture, and heating that makes a real difference on cold Mustang nights. The Nilgiri Restaurant serves Himalayan and international dishes, and the Aara Bar pours local spirits, including apple brandy from the valley.

Shinta Mani Mustang runs its own guided programme of walks, horse rides, cycling and cultural excursions to Muktinath, Kagbeni, Marpha and beyond, and its stays are usually sold as multi-night packages that include these activities. The wellness centre has treatment rooms facing the peaks with steam, sauna and a hot plunge pool, useful after a day on dusty trails. We recommend it for honeymooners and travellers who want comfort at altitude; book well ahead in spring and autumn.
why: The only true luxury resort in Mustang, opened in 2023
Heated suites, spa and a strong kitchen at 2,800 m
Guided excursions to Muktinath, Kagbeni and Upper Mustang

faqs.a: Shinta Mani Mustang is in Jomsom, Mustang district, at about 2,800 m, a short drive from Jomsom airport. Muktinath is about 1–1.5 hours away by road and Kagbeni about 40 minutes. The resort usually arranges transfers from the airport as part of its packages.

faqs.q: Is Shinta Mani Mustang suitable for Muktinath pilgrims?
faqs.a: Yes, for pilgrims wanting comfort. Sleeping at Jomsom's lower altitude and visiting Muktinath as a day trip is a sensible plan, and the resort's heated rooms help older guests sleep well. Tell us about dietary needs such as pure vegetarian or Jain food in advance so we can check with the kitchen.

faqs.q: How much does Shinta Mani Mustang cost?
faqs.a: Rates vary by season and package and are among the highest in Nepal, typically sold as all-inclusive multi-night stays with meals, activities and transfers. We quote current rates on request alongside our Mustang itineraries. Check current status before you travel, as packages and minimum stays change.

name: Hotel Om's Home
summary: Hotel Om's Home is a long-running 3-star hotel in central Jomsom, a few minutes' walk from the airstrip, with rooms around a traditional building and garden, a restaurant serving Thakali and Indian food and a convenient base for Muktinath and Upper Mustang.
body: Om's Home sits on Jomsom's main street, close enough to the airport that you can walk to an early flight with a porter carrying bags. The main part of the hotel is a traditional Thakali-style building, with newer wings around a small garden. Rooms have attached bathrooms, thick duvets for cold nights and simple regional decor. The restaurant serves Thakali sets, Indian vegetarian dishes and continental breakfasts, and the staff are used to cooking for pilgrim groups.

We use Om's Home for most of our Muktinath yatras and Jomsom tours because of its location, reliable hot water and friendly service. It is not a luxury hotel, and rooms vary in size and view, so ask for the newer wing if you prefer modern finishes. In peak months of April–May and October it fills with groups, so we book early. Wi-Fi works in common areas, though speed depends on the town's connection.
why: Walking distance from Jomsom airport for early flights
Kitchen experienced with Indian vegetarian and pilgrim groups
Traditional building with a garden, solid hot water and warm bedding

faqs.q: How far is Om's Home from Jomsom airport?
faqs.a: Om's Home is in central Jomsom, a few minutes' walk from the airstrip. Porters or the hotel can help with bags. This location is a real advantage on flight days, when check-in for the first Pokhara flight can be around 6 am and delays are announced at short notice.

faqs.q: Does Om's Home serve Indian vegetarian food?
faqs.a: Yes. The kitchen regularly cooks for Indian pilgrim groups and serves dal, rice, chapati, vegetable curries and Thakali sets. Jain food without onion and garlic can be arranged with advance notice. Breakfast includes options such as paratha, eggs, porridge and toast. Tell us your requirements when booking.

Rooms have warm bedding and some have heaters, and the dining area is kept warm in the evenings. In winter and early spring, nights in Jomsom drop below freezing, so ask for extra blankets or an electric blanket. Heating levels can depend on power supply. Check current status before you travel.

name: Red House Lodge
summary: Red House Lodge is one of Kagbeni's oldest lodges, set in a restored traditional house of several connected buildings around a centuries-old shrine room with a large clay Maitreya statue. It offers simple rooms with attached bathrooms in the heart of the old village.
body: The lodge occupies three joined buildings in Kagbeni's old core, with minimal modern changes. At its centre is a shrine room said to be more than 300 years old, holding a large clay statue of Maitreya Buddha on a carved and painted altar. The family has hosted travellers for decades, and the name came from a visitor who painted a signboard for the house, then entirely red. Rooms are simple and clean, with attached bathrooms and views over the rooftops or the river.

Staying here puts you within a few minutes of Kag Chode monastery, the Kali Gandaki confluence for Shaligram and shraddha, and the Upper Mustang checkpoint. The dining room serves Nepali, Tibetan and Western dishes. Facilities are those of a good village lodge rather than a hotel, so expect solar hot water and modest heating. We book it for trekkers starting Upper Mustang and for travellers who want one night in a characterful house.
why: Centuries-old house with its own shrine and Maitreya statue
In the old village, minutes from the monastery and the river
Ideal first night for Upper Mustang treks and jeep tours

faqs.q: Is Red House Lodge in Kagbeni comfortable?
faqs.a: It is a comfortable village lodge with clean rooms and attached bathrooms, not a hotel. Hot water is solar-heated and rooms are cool at night, with good blankets. What makes it special is the building and the shrine room. Guests who want heated rooms should stay in Jomsom and visit Kagbeni for the day.

faqs.q: Can non-guests visit the shrine at Red House Lodge?
faqs.a: Visitors often stop for tea or a meal and ask to see the shrine room with the Maitreya statue; the family usually agrees if it is convenient. Remove shoes, keep voices low and ask before taking photographs. A small donation is appreciated and helps maintain the old building.

faqs.q: Is Red House Lodge good for Upper Mustang treks?
faqs.a: Yes. Kagbeni is the gateway to Upper Mustang, and Red House Lodge is a short walk from the checkpoint, so it is an ideal place to spend the night before entering the restricted area. Many itineraries fly to Jomsom, walk or drive to Kagbeni and start north the next morning.

name: Royal Mustang Resort
summary: Royal Mustang Resort is a boutique hotel just outside the walls of Lo Manthang, built in traditional Tibetan style with around 20 heated rooms, regional art and textiles and a kitchen supplied by its own organic farm. It is the most comfortable place to stay in Upper Mustang.
body: The resort sits a short walk from the main gate of Lo Manthang at about 3,840 m. Its rooms and suites have wooden floors, lattice screens, wide beds, heating and reliable hot water, rare comforts in Upper Mustang. Many rooms face the walled city or the surrounding hills. Common areas are decorated with regional artwork and textiles, and the dining room serves a seasonal menu of Tibetan and international dishes using produce from the hotel's organic farm.

We use Royal Mustang Resort for our premium jeep tours, heli add-ons and festival trips, when guests value a warm room after long days at altitude. It is small, so it books out early, especially around Tiji in May. Expect friendly service and simple luxury rather than international chain standards. The hotel can help arrange horses, jeeps and gompa visits, though our guide handles most of this as part of the itinerary.
why: Heated rooms and hot water at 3,840 m
Steps from Lo Manthang's main gate
Kitchen supplied by its own organic farm

faqs.q: Is there a luxury hotel in Lo Manthang?
faqs.a: Royal Mustang Resort is the most comfortable hotel in Lo Manthang, a boutique property with heated rooms, hot water, regional decor and good food. It is not a five-star resort but offers a level of comfort well above the family lodges. Book months ahead for May and October.

faqs.q: Is Royal Mustang Resort open in winter?
faqs.a: Like most of Lo Manthang, the resort operates mainly from spring to late autumn. Many residents leave in winter when temperatures fall far below freezing. Opening dates vary year to year, so ask us before planning travel from December to February. Check current status before you travel.

faqs.q: How far is Royal Mustang Resort from the walled city?
faqs.a: It sits just outside the walls, a few minutes' walk from the main gate of Lo Manthang. Guests can walk into the old city, visit the monasteries and palace square and return for lunch or rest. The helipad used by heli tours is also nearby.
